text: Acme Robotics designs industrial warehouse robots. In fiscal 2024 the company sold 4,200 robot units and generated total net sales of $812 million.
Acme Robotics relies on Borealis Semiconductor as its sole supplier of motion-control chips. A disruption at Borealis could halt production for up to 12 weeks.
Acme Robotics gross margin was 38.5% in fiscal 2024 compared with 36.1% in fiscal 2023, driven by lower freight costs and a richer product mix.
Research and development expense at Acme Robotics was $96 million in fiscal 2024, representing 11.8% of net sales.
Borealis Semiconductor fabricates specialty microcontrollers and motion-control chips at its facility in Dresden, Germany, which produces all of its automotive and robotics products.
The Dresden facility is located in a flood-prone region. Borealis maintains no secondary fabrication site, and a prolonged flood would interrupt shipments to all customers.
Borealis Semiconductor reported net sales of $2.3 billion in fiscal 2024, up 7% year over year. Robotics customers accounted for 14% of net sales.
Borealis Semiconductor had long-term debt of $640 million as of December 31, 2024, with the next principal repayment of $150 million due in 2026.
Cedar Grocers operates 310 supermarkets across the Midwest United States and employed approximately 28,000 associates at fiscal year end 2024.
Cedar Grocers identical-store sales increased 3.4% in fiscal 2024, and net sales were $6.9 billion. Digital orders represented 11% of sales.
Cedar Grocers depends on a single regional distribution partner, Prairie Logistics, for refrigerated freight, and rising fuel prices could compress margins.
Cedar Grocers operating margin was 3.1% in fiscal 2024, and the company repurchased $120 million of common stock during the year.
